newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica net profit rose 20.1 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica net profit rose 20.1 pct in 1996.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications company Telefonica de Espana said on Wednesday its net profit rose 20.1 percent in 1996, in line with expectations.
After the bourse close, Telefonica announced its net profit rose to 160.03 billion pesetas from 133.21 in 1995, while its turnover rose 15.5 percent to 2.01 trillion pesetas.

The company, currently in the midst of the sale of the state's remaining 20.9 percent in the group, had said earlier its objective was to earn 160 billion pesetas in 1996. A Reuters survey of analysts had put expected profits at up 20.2 percent.
In a brief statement, Telefonica also said it had increased its mobile phone customers by 152.5 percent to 2.3 million at the end of 1996 over the year earlier.
The group said it will release complete audited results on February 28.
